blinds_now.title: Set up blinds now
blinds_now.description: Pick every cover Cover Logic should control. Next you will say which way each one faces, then a working starting setup is created for you -- you can change any of it later from the configuration menu. [Learn more]({docs_url}/getting-started/first-setup/)

blinds_now_summary.title: Starter setup

from_file.title: Load a configuration from a YAML file
from_file.description: Point Cover Logic at the YAML file describing your blinds, zones and rules. It is loaded and checked right away. [Learn more]({docs_url}/getting-started/first-setup/)

from_example.title: Start from the example configuration
from_example.description: Imports the worked example for a different, invented house (four windows, an away/night/home mode split) as a starting point. Edit or remove any of it afterwards from the configuration menu. [Learn more]({docs_url}/getting-started/first-setup/)

example_not_available.title: Example not available
example_not_available.description: This installation does not ship the example configuration. Continue to go back to the setup menu and pick a different way to start. [Learn more]({docs_url}/getting-started/first-setup/)

empty.title: Start empty

user.title: Add guard
user.description: Which policy, and where in the order. The policy decides which fields the next screen has, so it is asked first. [Learn more]({docs_url}/concepts/guards/)

data_description.policy: No default on purpose: the three policies do three different things.
data_description.order: Lower is tried first. Suggested as ten past the last guard, leaving room to slip one in between two later on. Two guards cannot share an order.

guard.title: Add guard
guard.description: Guards are tried in order and the first one that matches wins. A guard can skip a movement, defer it, or force a different action instead. [Learn more]({docs_url}/concepts/guards/)

data.targets: What it covers (leave empty for every blind in the house)
data.condition_ref: Named condition (leave empty to build one inline, or for a guard that always applies)
data.when: Inline condition (leave empty if using a named condition, or for a guard that always applies)

data_description.targets: Blinds and zones, mixed freely. Empty means every blind -- there is no difference here between 'unset' and 'all'.
data_description.applies_to: 'closing' means a falling position, not the slats; the default 'any' does not care which way.
data_description.stage: 'after the decision' overrides the action; 'before the decision' drops the target entirely and must use 'any'.
data_description.condition_ref: For a numeric threshold, name a condition -- the inline selector rejects the fallback value this needs.
data_description.position: Pick 'keep' to leave this axis alone, pick a configured value to read the number from that helper, or type a number from 0 to 100.
data_description.tilt: Pick 'keep' to leave this axis alone, pick a configured value to read the number from that helper, or type a number from 0 to 100.
data_description.wait_limit: 'no limit' waits until the condition clears; there is no default since the two choices differ.
data_description.max_wait_duration: Only read when 'at most' is chosen. Left at zero, the guard is refused rather than saved as a zero-second wait.
data_description.on_timeout: No default on purpose: dropping the movement and doing it anyway are opposites.
data_description.recheck_every: A deferred movement does not survive a Home Assistant restart, so this is the safety net that picks it up again.

import_export.title: Import / export configuration
import_export.description: Reads or writes the whole configuration as a YAML file -- the same import_config/export_config services Developer Tools can call directly. [Learn more]({docs_url}/reference/services/)

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Whether this integration moves the covers for real, or only logs what it would have done; dry run is the safe starting setting. [Learn more]({docs_url}/getting-started/shadow-mode/)

data_description.dry_run: On: nothing is moved, every intended command is written to the log. Off: covers really move. This takes effect immediately, with no reload.
data_description.fixture_path: Optional path to the YAML fixture the drift check compares against; leave empty for the default fixtures/ directory.
data_description.dead_band: How many points a reported position or tilt may differ from target before a command is sent; takes effect immediately.
